children: Japanese household spending in September fell 6.8% from a year earlier, internal affairs ministry data showed on Tuesday, versus the median market forecast for a 3.1% drop.
On a seasonally adjusted, month-on-month basis, spending decreased 2.8%, versus an estimated 0.3% rise.
To view the data on the website of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, click here: http://www.stat.go.jp/english/data/kakei/index.html
